goal: Allow developers and packagers to run native Guix builds on RISC-V architectures.
Resolves dependency and test failures that previously broke RISC-V host builds.
reviewability: Nothing known would invalidate a review now.
agreement: Strong support with verified builds and no open objections.
Verified matching Guix build outputs on x86_64 across updates (fanquake, willcl-ark, Sjors).

why: P3 because native RISC-V Guix building is not a tier-1 release platform, making this fix deferrable.
Enables builders on RISC-V hosts to produce native reproducible builds without failures.
